messages:
lauren: quick heads-up 3 PR #4321 has two broken anchors in the '429 & timeouts' runbook and the Node SDK snippet under /snippets/node/retries.md is out of date. can someone own a sweep?

mike: I can own the anchors. which anchors are failing?

lauren: the links from 'Fallback ordering' to the canary section and from the 'Client retries' note to the sdk snippet 404. sample anchor names: #canary-fallback and #client-retries. the node snippet also uses an old fetch wrapper.

anya: pinging @sam since you updated the node SDK earlier this week.

sam: yep, I changed the Node retry surface. I'll add a compat example and a short migration note. ETA ~2h.

docsbot: autolink-check: 2 broken anchors detected in docs/runbooks/429-timeouts.md; CI docs-link-checker failed (report: https://ci.internal/reports/9876).

mike: the headings moved under 'Fallback strategies'. plan: add markdown-style heading IDs (e.g., 'Canary fallback {#canary-fallback}') and update cross-doc links. also add a tiny header redirect to preserve older bookmarks. sound OK?

lauren: prefer markdown heading ids. avoid raw HTML anchors.

mike: will open a micro PR with aliases + TOC fix.

sam: draft snippet for docs (will include both old + new):
```js
// legacy (kept for 30 days)
await client.retry.generate(prompt, { maxRetries: 2 });

// new surface
await client.request.generate({ prompt, retries: { maxAttempts: 3 } });
```
I'll add a mapping table for client.retry.* -> client.request.* and a short deprecation note.

anya: QA checklist: 1) link-checker green 2) snippets run in playground CI 3) add changelog entry "docs: Node SDK retry compat examples". I'll take changelog and run playground tests.

lauren: owners: mike = anchors + cross-doc links; sam = node snippet + compat PR; anya = changelog + playground verification; lauren = merge when CI is green.

mike: branch pushed: mike/anchor-aliases-4321. tiny PR opened, requested reviews from @lauren and @anya.

sam: pushed sam/sdk-compat-4321 and left PR comment linking to mike's PR. included TODO for mapping table to be added to the runbook.

anya: re-ran link-checker locally after mike's changes 3 0 failures. will re-run after sam's snippet PR merges.

lauren: timeline: aim to merge EOD today if CI passes, otherwise Monday morning. :thumbsup:

mike: adding aliases should preserve external bookmarks.

sam: will keep legacy snippet visible for 30 days behind a compat callout.

docsbot: notify: PR 4321 updated with labels: docs, urgent, 429-runbook. CI status: pending (docs-link-checker, snippets-playground).

lauren: thanks everyone. I'll watch CI and merge once green. any other items?

mike: nothing else from me.

sam: all set.

anya: noted 3 I'll add the release note during deploy."
